Also flag these project logic / rule violations (AI Pharmacy OS):
- Sales that create, top up, or fabricate stock instead of rejecting insufficient real stock; stock math that sums quantity and loose_quantity as independent columns instead of one unit pool.
- Invented fallback business data (BATCH123, B-GEN, 12/28, default MRP/rate/expiry, mrp*0.7, dummy phone/address).
- Inventory created outside a verified purchase workflow.
- Any automatic (cron/worker/listener) WhatsApp/SMS message to patients/customers.
- UTC date strings for bill dates (toISOString().slice) or 'localtime' on stored bill dates.
- SQL built by string concatenation with user input; missing auth on new routes; secrets/tokens logged or committed.
- DB schema changes present in only one of: full migration block or fast-boot ensureSchema in src/database.ts.
- Eager refetch storms, ungated setInterval/refetchInterval polling, GPU-forcing Electron switches, native alert()/confirm().
- Delivery boy data read/written outside /dispatch and the delivery_boys table.
